repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an extra absolute-value calculation (lines 4-7) that does not exist in the IR. The IR checks the raw difference ($t2 - $t1 >= 3). If t2 < t1, the difference is negative, and the condition fails, so no action is taken. The candidate's logic flips the difference if it is negative, effectively checking |t2 - t1| >= 3, causing a false positive when the temperature drops.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value logic and the intermediate 'diff' variable. The script now directly computes the difference and checks the condition exactly as specified in the IR ($t2 - $t1 >= 3). This preserves the behavior that the action only triggers if the temperature rises by at least 3 units.
